style.backgroundSystem: clean white #FFFFFF for packshot and trust screens, cream apricot #F7EEDD for info and variant screens, charcoal #2E2B28 and dark walnut #4A3527 for dark appetite photography
style.iconSystem: rustic ink-brush frame accents and thin-line labels, single seal-red accent
style.lightingSystem: warm soft lighting with front-left key, gentle contact shadows, controlled highlights that keep natural moist sheen on the meat
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent fresh farm-to-table meat visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of cream apricot background #F7EEDD, charcoal text #2E2B28, seal-red accent #C8452C and dark walnut wood #4A3527; warm soft lighting with front-left key and gentle contact shadows; bold brush-calligraphy headlines with clean sans-serif labels; rustic ink-brush frame accents; natural fresh meat photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; true-to-life meat color and texture with stable scale; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
noDrift: no artificial color shift on the meat
style.presentationRules: true-to-life meat color and texture, cuts grounded with soft contact shadows, stable scale across the set
style.surfaceSystem: rustic dark walnut wood board #4A3527 and matte charcoal slate #2E2B28, with matte cream board #F7EEDD for infographic layouts
style.typography: bold brush-calligraphy headline style with clean sans-serif labels
